persona.brief:
On a real call to the studio you said:
- "I need to speak to someone right now. My project has been going for three months and my designer hasn’t replied in five days. This is not acceptable."
- "Sheetal Deshpande. My designer is Aryan. Flat in Viman Nagar — 2BHK. I’ve sent three messages and called twice."
- "Callback. And I want it from Nikhil or a senior person — not just whoever picks up."
Context:
- Existing project complaint. Escalated to studio head immediately.
Phone: you're calling from your own mobile.
persona.behaviour: You are upset. You want a callback from Nikhil or a senior person, not just anyone.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, you've reached Aangan Studio. I'm Aangan's AI assistant, and this call is recorded. May I have your name, please?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sheetal Deshpande. Look, I need to speak to a senior person right now. My project has been going for three months and my designer hasn’t replied in five days.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm so sorry to hear that, Sheetal. I will make sure a senior member of the team calls you back as soon as possible. When are you generally free to take a call?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I can take the call anytime this afternoon. But it has to be Nikhil or another senior person, not just anybody.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I completely understand, Sheetal. A senior member of our team will call you back as soon as possible. Thank you for letting us know, and have a good day.

complaint.summary: Existing client Sheetal Deshpande (2BHK Viman Nagar with designer Aryan) complains that her project has been going for three months and her designer hasn't replied in five days. Wants a senior person / Nikhil to call back.
